# Orleans.Lattice

> Orleans.Lattice is a sorted, durable, horizontally-scalable key-value store embedded directly in a Microsoft Orleans cluster. Keys are `string`, values are `byte[]`; the keyspace is sharded across self-balancing B+ trees whose state is backed by conflict-free (CRDT) lattice primitives, so the store converges deterministically without external databases, coordinators, or queues.

This file is the entry point for AI agents and LLM tooling. Documentation lives in-repo as Markdown under `docs/`, and every public type carries XML doc comments that ship in the NuGet packages. Prefer the linked Markdown over crawling source.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): Overview, the full feature matrix, quick start, and performance characteristics.
- [API Reference](docs/lattice/api.md): The public `ILattice` interface, batch operations, options, and serializable types.
- [Configuration](docs/lattice/configuration.md): Options reference, per-tree overrides, immutability constraints, storage-provider registration.
- [Samples](docs/lattice/samples.md): Runnable sample projects exercising `ILattice`.
- [Consistency](docs/lattice/consistency.md): The per-operation guarantee matrix (what is strongly consistent, what is eventually convergent).

## Core concepts

- [Architecture](docs/lattice/architecture.md): Grain layers, sharding, root promotion, grain mapping, capacity.
- [Tree structure](docs/lattice/tree-structure.md): Internal/leaf node layout, two-phase leaf splits, idempotent split propagation.
- [State model](docs/lattice/state-model.md): WAL as canonical truth; leaf row holds topology + checkpoint only; delta-only CRDT mutation.
- [State primitives](docs/lattice/state-primitives.md): The CRDT/lattice value types and how concurrent writes converge.
- [WAL](docs/lattice/wal.md): The write-ahead log as the sole foreground-commit durability boundary.
- [Shard splitting](docs/lattice/shard-splitting.md): Online, caller-transparent rebalancing of hot shards.

## Key capabilities

- [Atomic writes](docs/lattice/atomic-writes.md): All-or-nothing multi-key writes within a tree and across trees.
- [Atomic action](docs/lattice/atomic-action.md): Generic saga / TCC coordinator keyed by an operation id - runs an ordered plan of forward/compensating steps all-or-nothing, with a built-in tree-write step and crash-recoverable idempotency.
- [Distributed lock](docs/lattice/distributed-lock.md): FIFO-fair, cluster-wide lock / lease with monotonic fencing tokens and bounded leases.
- [Predicate operations](docs/lattice/predicated-operations.md): Server-side `Expression<Func<T,bool>>` push-down for reads, writes, scans, cursors, and range deletes.
- [Durable cursors](docs/lattice/durable-cursors.md): Server-checkpointed iterators that survive silo failover and client restart.
- [Snapshots](docs/lattice/snapshots.md) and [snapshot cursors](docs/lattice/snapshot-cursors.md): Point-in-time copies and isolated iteration.
- [Materialised views](docs/lattice/materialised-views.md) and [history views](docs/lattice/history-views.md): WAL-driven projections and per-key revision history.
- [TTL](docs/lattice/ttl.md), [tag indexes](docs/lattice/api.md#tag-indexes), [queues](docs/lattice/queues.md), [compression](docs/lattice/compression.md), [metrics](docs/lattice/metrics.md).

## Optional packages

- [Replication](docs/lattice.replication/README.md): Cross-cluster active-active replication (`Orleans.Lattice.Replication`).
- [Replication gRPC transport](docs/lattice.replication.grpc/README.md): The canonical gRPC push transport (`Orleans.Lattice.Replication.Grpc`).
- [API contract](docs/lattice.api.abstractions/README.md): Shared transport-agnostic facade interfaces and their DTOs for the API packages (`Orleans.Lattice.Api.Abstractions`).
- [State API](docs/lattice.api.state/README.md): Read-only cluster state facade (`Orleans.Lattice.Api.State`).
- [State API gRPC binding](docs/lattice.api.state.grpc/README.md): Code-first gRPC binding and client (`Orleans.Lattice.Api.State.Grpc`).
- [Azure Table WAL backend](docs/lattice.storage.azuretable/README.md): Durable WAL storage (`Orleans.Lattice.Storage.AzureTable`).
- [Grafana dashboards](docs/lattice.dashboards/README.md): Bundled dashboards for the Lattice meters (`Orleans.Lattice.Dashboards`).
- [Autoscaling signal](docs/lattice.scaling/README.md): Cluster-aggregate compute-axis replica-demand scalar for KEDA plus an advisory storage-axis WAL rebalance recommendation (`Orleans.Lattice.Scaling`).
- [Schema enforcement and versioning](docs/lattice.schema/README.md): Opt-in per-tree write validation with dead-letter diversion and self-describing value versioning with read-time upcasting, over the opaque-`byte[]` core (`Orleans.Lattice.Schema`).
- [Schema control API](docs/lattice.api.schema/README.md): Transport-agnostic schema-management facade - policy, dead letters, versioning, remediation, and compliance audit (`Orleans.Lattice.Api.Schema`).
- [Schema control API gRPC binding](docs/lattice.api.schema.grpc/README.md): Code-first gRPC binding and client for the schema control facade (`Orleans.Lattice.Api.Schema.Grpc`).
- [Tree-administration control API](docs/lattice.api.treeadmin/README.md): Transport-agnostic whole-tree administration facade that composes the schema control facade by delegation - a fail-closed per-operation capability probe plus the whole-tree lifecycle surface (create, reconfigure, delete/recover/purge, bulk load, restore, reshard, resize, snapshot, WAL placement audit and movement, view and tag-index management) (`Orleans.Lattice.Api.TreeAdmin`).
- [Tree-administration control API gRPC binding](docs/lattice.api.treeadmin.grpc/README.md): Code-first gRPC binding and typed client for the tree-administration control facade (`Orleans.Lattice.Api.TreeAdmin.Grpc`).
- [Multi-tenancy](docs/lattice.tenancy/README.md): Opt-in multi-tenancy - tenant-scoped trees with complete isolation, per-tenant quotas and rate limiting, tenant lifecycle, per-tenant observability, and per-tenant region residency, layered over a small number of generic core seams (`Orleans.Lattice.Tenancy`).
- [Tenant-administration control API](docs/lattice.api.tenantadmin/README.md): Transport-agnostic tenant-administration facades - the tenant lifecycle, each tenant's region residency, and a tenant-scoped tree-administration surface - over which every transport binding is a thin adapter (`Orleans.Lattice.Api.TenantAdmin`).
- [Tenant-administration control API gRPC binding](docs/lattice.api.tenantadmin.grpc/README.md): Code-first gRPC binding and typed client for the tenant-administration control facade (`Orleans.Lattice.Api.TenantAdmin.Grpc`).
- [Explorer web console](docs/lattice.explorer/README.md): Opt-in, auth-aware web console for a running cluster - a tree browser plus capability-gated admin areas over the gRPC APIs, composed from plugin packages a head opts into one at a time (`Orleans.Lattice.Explorer.Web`).
- [Writing an Explorer plugin](docs/lattice.explorer/writing-a-plugin.md): The Explorer's extension model - adding a console tab as its own package with its own domain contract, access gate, and adaptive styling, without editing the shell (`Orleans.Lattice.Explorer.Plugins.Abstractions`).
- [Explorer interactive Entra sign-in](docs/lattice.explorer.entra/README.md): Interactive Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) sign-in for the desktop/CLI Explorer - an OIDC auth-code + PKCE (or device-code) flow that acquires and silently refreshes a State API bearer token, keeping the MSAL dependency out of the core explorer (`Orleans.Lattice.Explorer.Entra`).
- [Explorer hosted-web Entra sign-in](docs/lattice.explorer.entra.web/README.md): Hosted-web Microsoft Entra ID (OpenID Connect) sign-in for the Blazor Server Explorer over Microsoft.Identity.Web, exchanging the browser session for a State API bearer token (`Orleans.Lattice.Explorer.Entra.Web`).
- [Azure Blob distributed cache](docs/lattice.caching.azureblob/README.md): A durable Azure Blob Storage `IDistributedCache` backing the hosted-web Explorer's distributed token cache on a multi-replica host (`Orleans.Lattice.Caching.AzureBlob`).
- [MCP server](docs/lattice.api.mcp/README.md): Model Context Protocol server exposing the state, data, backup, and auth facades as fail-closed, permission-scoped tools an AI agent can discover and call over streamable HTTP (`Orleans.Lattice.Api.Mcp`).
- [MCP telemetry tools](docs/lattice.api.mcp.telemetry/README.md): Opt-in companion exposing read-only cluster OpenTelemetry metrics over MCP behind a distinct `Telemetry` grant and a Prometheus/PromQL proxy (`Orleans.Lattice.Api.Mcp.Telemetry`).
- [MCP telemetry Azure token auth](docs/lattice.api.mcp.telemetry.azure/README.md): Azure managed-identity backend-token provider that lets the telemetry proxy query an Azure Monitor managed-Prometheus workspace with a rotating Entra token (`Orleans.Lattice.Api.Mcp.Telemetry.Azure`).
